name.es: Pila de controladora de vuelo de 30.5 × 30.5 mm
name.fr: Pile de contrôleur de vol 30,5 × 30,5 mm
name.pt: Pilha de controladora de voo de 30,5 × 30,5 mm

description.en: The flight-controller (and ESC) board class that mounts on a 30.5 × 30.5 mm M3 pattern through Ø4 mm holes fitted with M3 grommets. It mates the frame's stack mount by its bottom board.
description.es: La clase de placas de controladora de vuelo (y ESC) que se montan en un patrón M3 de 30.5 × 30.5 mm por barrenos de Ø4 mm con gomas para M3. Se une al montaje de pila del marco por su placa inferior.
description.fr: La classe de cartes de contrôleur de vol (et d'ESC) montées sur un motif M3 de 30,5 × 30,5 mm par des trous de Ø4 mm munis d'œillets M3. Elle s'accouple à la fixation de pile du châssis par sa carte inférieure.
description.pt: A classe de placas de controladora de voo (e ESC) montadas num padrão M3 de 30,5 × 30,5 mm por furos de Ø4 mm com anilhas de borracha M3. Acopla à fixação da pilha do quadro pela placa inferior.

sources.title: Matek F405-HDTE flight controller
sources.supports: 36 × 36 × 9 mm; mounting 30.5 × 30.5 mm; Φ4 mm holes with Φ3 mm grommets; 7 g

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the 30.5 mm hole square, on the bottom face of the lowest board. +z up through the stack; +x toward the board's forward arrow; +y to the left.

interfaces.note: Female: the grommeted holes receive the frame's bolts or standoffs. Symmetry 4: the pattern is square (board yaw is a firmware setting).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: the mounting pattern is the shared fact; board size, height and mass are those of the cited Matek F405-HDTE and vary across the class.
